purpose: Default small-scale operation for one independent artist or a small business, not an enterprise fleet.
precedence: This profile simplifies routine task selection but does not override existing security, source-truth, ownership, quarantine, rights, or publication gates.

personal.intent: Private art, prototypes, experiments, local play and iterative design
personal.prefer: Local-first with direct GitHub connector; use existing Render service only when browser/mobile verification needs it

smallBusiness.intent: Portfolio, client deliverables, invoiced art, reusable products and small-scale sales

publicOrSensitive.intent: Publishing, paid integrations, rights-pending assets, authentication changes, secrets, production deployment, destructive operations
workflow: retain existing canonical audit, permission and release gates

costs.rule: Do not create paid resources or recurring subscriptions without cost, limits and Professor approval.
costs.defaultInfra: Existing GitHub repository plus existing Render services plus local development
costs.optimize: Reuse existing hosting; avoid duplicate deployments; batch external calls; use local tools and caches for creative previews.

collaboration.executionPath: GitHub Direct plus supported connected tools; no Codex for the current chat workflow
collaboration.semantics: Role assignments are labels and guidance. Do not claim separate running agents or background workers without runtime proof.
collaboration.parallelism: Independent read-only checks may run together; one mutable GitHub branch or target at a time.
collaboration.agentRoster: Keep canonical 15-role registry for compatibility, but load only relevant roles for active tasks.

development.gitPolicy: Small focused commits, PR when collaboration or release risk warrants; no automatic merge or deploy.
development.CI: Targeted tests for changed code; reusable workflows and path filters where safe; do not delete existing protections without proof.
development.proof: Separate source configured, tests passed, Render live, plugin installed, browser working, and physical device verified.

assets.sourceStorage: Keep private Blender masters and donor archives in authorized private storage, not in the public repository or plugin package.
assets.package: Bundle tiny icons, manifests, and safe starter art only.
assets.delivery: Load approved optimized GLB/WebP/audio/video assets on demand; cache per browser limits.
assets.publication: Rights-pending EVE/Rebel materials remain private until approved.

privacyAndSafety.access: Least privilege, no secret in Git or published JavaScript, and consent before external client delivery.
privacyAndSafety.backup: Keep editable masters and a recovery copy before destructive changes.
privacyAndSafety.businessBoundary: Separate client media, contracts, tax/payment records and personal art files; public GitHub is not a private archive.
privacyAndSafety.auth: Retain validated authentication for any user-specific or mutating remote tool; the current public read-only MCP must not gain write rights implicitly.

deployPolicy: No automatic production, paid, business-client, public or signing actions from this profile alone.
notes: Lean does not mean insecure; avoid company theater, but keep safe defaults.
